title: Support hosting the site under a new domain/name (custom domain setting)

requirements.text: Add a persistent "custom domain / site name" setting in the backend that an admin can save and later retrieve (e.g., `customDomain : ?Text`).

quotes: I want to host it with new name

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method to retrieve the currently saved custom domain (returns null/empty when not set).
Backend exposes an admin-only update method to set/clear the custom domain.
Non-admin callers attempting to update the custom domain receive an authorization error.
No existing organization content endpoints are broken by the type/schema change.

requirements.text: Update the Admin Dashboard "Domain" tab to save the validated domain to the backend and to show the currently saved domain value.

quotes: I want to host it with new name

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Validate Domain" still validates using the existing `normalizeDomain` + `validateCustomDomain` logic.
If validation passes, the UI calls the backend to persist the domain and shows a success toast confirming it was saved.
The Domain tab displays the currently saved domain on load (and after saving) so the admin can confirm what is configured.
If the backend update fails (e.g., not authenticated), the UI shows an error toast and does not falsely indicate the domain was saved.

requirements.text: Add clear English-only guidance in the Admin "Domain" tab explaining what the custom domain setting does and what manual steps are required to actually use the new domain (DNS + IC/custom domain setup), including that the existing `uthaansewasamiti-1eg.caffeine.xyz` URL will still work unless a domain is properly pointed.

quotes: I want to host it with new name

acceptanceCriteria: The Domain tab includes a short, readable set of steps describing that purchasing/controlling the domain and configuring DNS is required.

The text explicitly mentions the current live address `uthaansewasamiti-1eg.caffeine.xyz` as the existing working URL and clarifies that saving a domain in the dashboard alone does not automatically change hosting.
All new user-facing guidance text is in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity remains the only supported auth mechanism.
nonGoals: Buying a domain name for the user or integrating with a domain registrar.
Automatically configuring DNS records or completing IC boundary-node/custom-domain registration on the user’s behalf.
Changing the live Caffeine subdomain automatically (e.g., renaming `uthaansewasamiti-1eg.caffeine.xyz`) without a redeploy/hosting-level change.
